blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vlogger Norman Mangusin, also known as “Francis Leo Marcos,” has been arrested again over alleged illegal use of uniforms, the National Police Commission (Napolcom) confirmed on Thursday. According to Napolcom Commissioner Rafael Calinisan, the Philippine National Police–Criminal Investigation and Detection Group apprehended Mangusin, who was transported to Camp Crame in Quezon City
